cd-shell-lake-legion-pavilion-1924.st: The pavilion was busy for a long time. Newspapers.com has about 428 mentions of it from 1920 to 1940. In May 1936 Slim Jim and his Rough Riders played to "the usual large attendance" (Washburn County Register, 7 May 1936, p. 1), and dances there were still front-page news in 1939-40. Heavy crowds from the mid-1920s to after 1940 make this a strong coin site.
src: Washburn County Register, 7 May 1936, p. 1 (newspapers.com image 1356164348)

cd-weyerhaeuser-ellison-pavilion-1922.st: A September 1922 item places Ellison's pavilion "a short distance out from the village" of Weyerhaeuser (Ladysmith News-Budget, 15 Sep 1922, p. 1).

cd-island-lake-getchel-pavilion-1922.st: The same 15 Sep 1922 News-Budget item that names Ellison's pavilion also names Getchel's at Island Lake.
